4694-5805-7306-8227.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4694-5805-7306-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

4279-4976-5708--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-4976-5708--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper, Open the Graves and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Open the Graves ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-6642-8201.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6642-8201.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, SOLDIER Military Program triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-6642-8201.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of SOLDIER Military Program's modes.

277-4863-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
277-4863-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Revolutionist and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Revolutionist and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
277-4863-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Revolutionist and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

978-2511--5.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature with persist
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5789-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5789-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1170-3836-5131-6797--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3836-5131-6797--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Urza.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

413-618-3817.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller with haste.
When the Sister Hospitaller token enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life
When Kiki-Jiki enters, Blasting Station triggers. Resolve both Blasting Station triggers from this step and step 4, untapping it.
Repeat.

776-1368-2196.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
You control up to three lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
776-1368-2196.description:
Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search for its escape cost by paying {2}{U} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Jeskai Ascendancy's first and second abilities trigger. Resolve both triggers, causing you to loot, untap all creatures you control and give them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap three lands.
Repeat.

3259-5223-7358.easyPrerequisites: You don't control a Devil token.
3259-5223-7358.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5223-7358.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Maestros Diabolist as attackers.
Maestros Diabolist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

1402-3593-4359-5256.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Diamond Lion from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Garna enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Diamond Lion by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Garna.
Resolve the Garna ability from step 3, returning all creature cards that were put in your graveyard this turn to your hand.
Repeat.

751-2757-7165.description:
Activate Pristine Angel by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Pristine Angel triggers, untapping it.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Activate a basic Island you control by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself.
Holding priority, activate Earthcraft by tapping Shrieking Drake, untapping a tapped basic Island.
Resolve Shrieking Drake's trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2609-2757-4249-5094.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to white is at least 6.
2609-2757-4249-5094.description:
Activate Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least six {W}
Cast Recruit the Worthy with buyback by paying {3}{W}, creating a creature token and returning Recruit the Worthy to your hand.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the creature token, untapping Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx.
Repeat.

1170-1329-4708-6965.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Dark Sphere from your graveyard.
Cast Dark Sphere by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

826-1636-6797-6935.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing Otherworldly Escort to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Spirit Detective.
When Otherworldly Escort enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

3705-4050-4556-6896.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Blight Mound triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

4871-5544-6011-6798.notablePrerequisites: Scavenger's Talent is at least level 2.
4871-5544-6011-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Scavenger's Talent's second ability triggers, targeting an opponent, and Pitiless Plunderer triggers.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Scavenger's Talent trigger, causing an opponent to mill two cards.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

338-4716-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-4716-5641.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1912-2043-3129-4715.description:
Activate Urza by paying {4}, creating two token copies of Prized Statue that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
When the Prized Statue tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

2724-3217-3582-5686.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Repeat each turn.

1912-4499-5424.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Sailor of Means.
When Sailor of Means enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1636-2595-3490.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}.
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it.
Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2595-3490.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, causing each creature you control to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it this turn.
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield, which enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Intruder Alarm and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate a mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Repeat from step 3.

447-776-1329-2709.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Mechanics do not have summoning sickness.
447-776-1329-2709.description:
Tap Orcish Mechanics, sacrificing Gustha's Scepter to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Gustha's Scepter.
Cast Gustha's Scepter.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

132-1766-2645.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Thran Dynamo's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Myr Welder using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
132-1766-2645.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use any other ability from Staff of Domination in step 1 instead.

3617-5021-5261.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2}, casting a copy of Noxious Revival without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the Noxious Revival, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
